title: Gestão Financeira API Specification
description: Comprehensive specification of all RESTful API endpoints, request parameters, bodies, and response models for the Gestão Financeira system.

security.description: All endpoints require 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header except /api/auth/register, /api/auth/login, and /health. Missing or invalid tokens return 401 Unauthorized RFC 7807 problem details.
security.refreshToken: HttpOnly cookie 'gf_refresh', 30-day session max, CSRF header 'X-Requested-With: GestaoFinanceira' required on /refresh and /logout

routes.description: Registers a user with email and password, hashes password via Argon2id, issues a short-lived JWT access token and sets an HttpOnly refresh cookie.

400.description: Validation error or email already registered

routes.description: Validates email and password using constant-time Argon2id verification, issues a short-lived JWT access token, and sets an HttpOnly refresh cookie.

routes.summary: Rotate refresh token and issue new access token
routes.description: Rotates the refresh token family with reuse detection and issues a new JWT access token. Requires HttpOnly 'gf_refresh' cookie and 'X-Requested-With: GestaoFinanceira' CSRF header.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

routes.summary: Log out and revoke active refresh token
routes.description: Revokes the active refresh token family and clears the 'gf_refresh' cookie. Requires 'X-Requested-With: GestaoFinanceira' CSRF header.
